item.title: gs-quant: Goldman Sachs Python Toolkit Built on 25 Years of Quant
item.description: Goldman Sachs open-sourced gs-quant, giving Python developers and AI finance agents battle-tested derivatives pricing, backtesting, and portfolio risk modules.

item.title: Local Korean PII Detection and Pseudonymization with ko-pii
item.description: ko-pii detects and pseudonymizes 33 Korean personal data types locally using Python’s standard library, regex rules, and checksums with zero external API calls.

item.title: Prime Agent: Solving Context Bloat in Long-Running Coding Agents with RLM
item.description: Prime Agent replaces static file-reading tools with a persistent IPython REPL and Recursive Language Model architecture for multi-hour coding sessions.

item.title: Scrapling: Adaptive Python Web Scraping That Survives UI Redesigns
item.description: Scrapling tracks moved DOM elements automatically when websites change class names, combining anti-bot stealth, proxy rotation, and MCP agent integration.

item.title: Hands-On Jupyter Notebooks for LangChain v1, LangGraph, and Deep Agents
item.description: Legacy chain examples broke with LangChain v1. This Jupyter notebook repository walks step by step through State and Node control in LangGraph and Deep Agents.

item.title: Serverless Daily Market Briefings with Python, GitHub Actions, and Telegram
item.description: Macro-Pulse automates daily equity, rate, and commodity tracking without a dedicated server using Python, GitHub Actions cron jobs, and Telegram alerts.

item.title: Why Preprocessing Drives RAG Quality: Converting Docs with MarkItDown
item.description: MarkItDown converts PDFs and Office files into Markdown while preserving tables and heading hierarchies, cutting RAG preprocessing work.
